dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Inventory refers to the entire transport life cycle. Airport infrastructure expenditures and environmental interventions are accounted for using the yearly transport performance at Zurich airport (73'526'350'051 pkm/a). Aircraft manufacturing is allocated based on the total life span of an aircraft (50'000LTO), the average distance of a flight (2800km) and its average number of passengers (132p/unit); UUID: ef503551-6c2f-3ed6-8dff-d012e8f1d80b

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Start date refers to emission factor data. End date refers to year of reporting fuel consumption and transport activities

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Aircraft operation modelled based on passenger aircrafts operated by Lufthansa Group in 2019. The emission profiles distinguish between LTO and cruise.

# Included processes
The dataset describes the operation of aircrafts including taxying, take-off and landing covering fuel consumption and operation emissions. Aircraft manufacture and maintenance, airport construction, operation and dismantling are inputs to this dataset

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: fuel consumption is based on corporate data, emission profiles are based on FOEN statistics
